change_summary: CBB RUN IT: phone-triggered orchestration around the existing frozen CBBD-native model and paper contracts. Captures CBBD ratings (existing daily_ratings_capture), /games (existing capture_games) and /games/teams possessions plus ESPN scoreboard; builds slate, prior finals, ESPN venue registry and exact-ID quotes; calls unchanged cbbd_paper_card.build_card and cbbd_paper_ledger; publishes a sanitized PAPER/0u card with withheld reasons. Fails closed on missing keys, possessions, identity mismatches and neutral-site disagreement.
assumptions: CBBD /games/teams teamStats.possessions field name is from public docs; absence fails closed (no prior finals).
DraftKings board price_a = home/over: verified 43/43 for spread vs moneyline favourite; total side order assumed from board layout.
ESPN scoreboard neutralSite is a declared source, not authenticated; build_card requires it to agree with CBBD.
Frozen CBBD-native model is unvalidated; synthetic tests are not predictive validation.

baseline.metric: Prospective untouched CFB forecast accuracy versus same-time market
